contexts.text: There are theoretical truths of faith, and practical ones. He who regards the theoretical ones in the practical ones, and sees the former in the latter... is in faith from the Lord. Explained.
Such are theoretically evil; but those are practically evil who make the Divine precepts of no account...

These (principles) are theoretical and practical. The theoretical are such things as imbue the understanding, but still can be expunged from it. But the practical are those which pass through the will into actions, and flow from the love... and then acquire habit, and form the spontaneous Natural itself...
They call the former practical religion, and the latter Christian religion...
They know that practical religion is the way to Heaven, and not the theoretical way.
